clauses.text:
EXECUTIVE ORDER 10315
Exemption op William E. L ee From Com­
pulsory R etirement for A ge
WHEREAS William E. Lee, a member 
of the Interstate Commerce Commission, 
will, during the month of January 1952, 
become subject to compulsory retirement 
for age under the provisions of the Civil 
Service Retirement Act of May 29, 1930, 
as amended, unless exempted therefrom 
by Executive order; and
WHEREAS, in my judgment, the pub­
lic interest requires that the said person 
be exempted from such compulsory re­
tirement as provided below:
NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the 
authority vested in me by section 204 of 
the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 404 
(5 U S. C. 715a), I hereby exempt the 
said William E. Lee from compulsory 
retirement for age for an indefinite 
period of time not extending beyond the 
expiration of his present term of office as 
a member of the Interstate Commerce 
'Commission: Provided, that, for the pur­
poses of this order, his present term 
of office shall be considered as expiring 
upon the appointment and qualification 
of his successor.
